manual_cycle_rule: T-minus checkpoints are temporal capture gates. T-10 is the immutable pre-match evidence and decision freeze; missed checkpoints are never reconstructed after kickoff.

post_kickoff_observations.observation: Cody Walker left the match with a reported calf injury.
Official NRL match state records full time: Rabbitohs 10, Knights 20.

Independent reporting states Newcastle won 20-10; Jermaine McEwen scored twice, Dane Gagai and Dominic Young also contributed tries, while South Sydney's attack was disrupted after Cody Walker left injured.

structural_baseline.season_point_differential_latest_support: Rabbitohs approximately +113; Knights approximately +42 before Round 27 bye
structural_baseline.recent_scoring: Rabbitohs won final two regular-season matches 42-22 and 50-20; Knights lost 46-32 in Round 26 then had Round 27 bye
structural_baseline.venue_context: Allianz Stadium; Rabbitohs' Round 27 50-20 win is down-weighted because Sydney rested a large senior cohort
structural_baseline.roster_continuity: Official pre-match core starting 17/interchange structures remained stable through the latest captured pre-kickoff checkpoint

player_effects: Rabbitohs: Tallis Duncan return remained verified in the pre-match state.
Knights: Dominic Young, Tyson Frizell and Phoenix Crossland returns remained verified in the pre-match state.
Persistent player layer remains complete; no post-kickoff evidence is allowed to rewrite the pre-match selection.
fixtures.matchup_memory: The 2026 meetings were high-scoring and competitive; prior interaction was treated as a counterweight to overconfidence.
fixtures.weather: Latest captured pre-match Sydney state: 0 mm, about 10% rain chance and light winds; no demonstrated directional edge.
fixtures.opposing_case: Newcastle's Round 27 rest plus the verified returns of Young, Frizell and Crossland preserved a credible upset mechanism around Ponga, Gagai, Best and Marzhew.
fixtures.falsification: The pre-match Rabbitohs edge would have required reduction if late lists weakened South Sydney spine/middle continuity or materially strengthened Newcastle continuity before the freeze.
fixtures.evidence_family_independence: Market is not independent corroboration. Official roster evidence, observed results and matchup history remain distinct evidence families.

structural_baseline.recent_scoring: Warriors six straight wins; Dolphins seven straight wins
structural_baseline.venue_context: Go Media Stadium home final; Warriors won eight of 10 there this season
structural_baseline.roster_continuity: Official Finals Week 1 squads verified; player dossier layer complete; restored combinations tested as unit effects under active failure-audit learning

player_effects: Warriors: Leka Halasima, Wayde Egan and Kurt Capewell were officially named to return; Jackson Ford remained on the interchange in the latest captured pre-kickoff state.
Dolphins: Selwyn Cobbo, Kodi Nikorima and Kulikefu Finefeuiaki were officially restored.

Role-critical official profiles at three hours before kickoff: James Fisher-Harris 21 appearances, 631 tackles and 140 average running metres; Te Maire Martin 12 try assists from 11 appearances; Wayde Egan 12 try assists and 697 tackles from 23 appearances; Isaiya Katoa 17 try assists and 482 average kicking metres from 20 appearances; Kodi Nikorima 16 try assists and 23 line-break assists from 20 appearances; Hamiso Tabuai-Fidow 13 tries, 77 tackle breaks and 184 average running metres from 19 appearances.
fixtures.matchup_memory: Dolphins beat Warriors 26-24 in Round 17; retained as a genuine counterweight, not proof of current superiority.
fixtures.weather: Latest genuine pre-kickoff capture: Auckland windy around the match window, about 14-15C with low rain expectation. Wind was retained as execution variance only; no demonstrated directional team edge.
fixtures.opposing_case: Dolphins entered on a seven-match winning streak, beat the Warriors 26-24 in Round 17, restored Cobbo/Nikorima/Finefeuiaki as a unit, and carried verified role-critical attack through Katoa, Nikorima and Tabuai-Fidow.
fixtures.falsification: The pre-kickoff Warriors edge required reduction or switch if game-day lists materially weakened Warriors middle/spine continuity, Dolphins restored combinations remained intact while Warriors returns were restricted, or reliable market movement continued materially toward the Dolphins without offsetting independent evidence.
fixtures.evidence_family_independence: Market is not counted as independent corroboration; season differential, venue/results, official availability, official player statistics, prior head-to-head and weather are separated.

structural_baseline.recent_scoring: Sharks lost final two games 38-18 to Eels and 24-20 to Storm; Cowboys beat Wests Tigers 24-10 then lost 50-30 to Raiders
structural_baseline.venue_context: Allianz Stadium neutralises Cronulla home-ground advantage
structural_baseline.roster_continuity: Official Finals Week 1 squads verified; Hohepa Puru late withdrawal creates a minor Sharks bench-utility continuity downgrade; core spine remains intact

player_effects: Sharks: Hohepa Puru is out due to illness and Niwhai Puru takes the bench utility role; Braydon Trindall is cleared to play with his shoulder heavily strapped after missing two games; Nicho Hynes, Blayke Brailey, KL Iro, Teig Wilton and Thomas Hazelton remain available.
Cowboys: Jeremiah Nanai, Griffin Neame and Zac Laybutt are verified returns; Reuben Cotter is available; Sam McIntyre is on the interchange in place of Thomas Mikaele.
Persistent player statistical dossiers remain active; no new per-round publication at this checkpoint justifies a new causal trend claim.
fixtures.matchup_memory: Cowboys beat Sharks 46-34 in Round 8 on 24 April 2026; Sharks have won 14 of the last 17 against the Cowboys according to official NRL late mail. Both are retained as observed interaction history only.
fixtures.weather: Three hours before kickoff capture: Sydney around 17C and sunny, with dry evening conditions and winds expected to ease; NON_DIRECTIONAL.
fixtures.opposing_case: North Queensland's verified returns, Cotter availability, prior Round 8 win, Cronulla's weak recent form and current market movement toward the Cowboys are the strongest evidence-supported case against the Sharks selection.
fixtures.falsification: Reduce Sharks edge if late-list continuity shifts further toward North Queensland, Cronulla spine/middle continuity weakens, or reliable market movement continues toward the Cowboys without offsetting independent evidence.
fixtures.evidence_family_independence: Market, season differential, recent results, official availability, matchup history, weather and player statistical dossiers are not double-counted.

structural_baseline.recent_scoring: Panthers beat Bulldogs 24-10 and Wests Tigers 38-10; Roosters' Round 27 loss is down-weighted due to extensive resting
structural_baseline.roster_continuity: Official Finals Week 1 squads verified; player dossier layer complete; Angus Crichton is now ruled out and Egan Butcher enters the Roosters line-up

player_effects: Panthers: Isaah Yeo is officially named at starting lock and Scott Sorensen on the interchange.
Roosters: Angus Crichton is ruled out after failing to overcome a foot injury; Egan Butcher enters the line-up. James Tedesco, Daly Cherry-Evans, Reece Robson and Victor Radley remain restored.
Roosters low-sample players remain uncertainty unless directional evidence emerges.
fixtures.matchup_memory: Official NRL late mail states Penrith have won 12 of the last 14 against the Roosters; retained as observed matchup history only.
fixtures.weather: A day before kickoff capture: Sydney Sunday forecast pleasant with sunny spells and breezy conditions developing in the afternoon, around 23C maximum. No demonstrated directional team edge.
fixtures.opposing_case: Roosters still restore Tedesco, Cherry-Evans, Robson and Radley, but Crichton's verified withdrawal weakens the restored-senior-cohort counter-case relative to the earlier checkpoint.
fixtures.falsification: Reduce Panthers edge if late lists weaken Penrith spine/middle continuity or remaining restored Roosters roles materially strengthen at formal checkpoints.
fixtures.evidence_family_independence: Market is not independent corroboration; season differential, current availability, venue/results, matchup history, weather and rested-roster context are separated.
